Container.Name: Spool
Container.Overview: Spool is a YouTube-like self-hosted web player for your personal video library. It features channels, community posts, livestream archives, secure access (VHS passwords), and extensive library management.

Config.Name: App Name
Config.Description: The name of your application instance displayed in the UI.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: The port used to access the web interface.

Config.Name: App Data Path
Config.Description: Path to store the SQLite database and generated thumbnails.

Config.Name: Media Directory
Config.Description: Path to your existing video library.

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Required on first run to setup the initial admin account. Leave blank after the first successful start.

Config.Name: JWT Secret
Config.Description: Secret key used for secure session tokens. Change this to a random string!

Config.Name: Trust Proxy
Config.Description: Set to 'true' if you are running this container behind a reverse proxy (like Nginx Proxy Manager or SWAG).

Config.Name: Enable CSP
Config.Description: Enable Content Security Policy. Disable only if you have rendering issues.
